name: International Rescue Committee
story: Every **{malnutrition: grant_size_to_charity_burkina_faso / number_of_malnourished_children_reached_burkina_faso|$}** given to the International Rescue Committee treats one malnourished child, and every **{malnutrition: grant_size_to_charity_burkina_faso / total_number_of_deaths_averted_among_malnourished_children_b|$}** saves a child's life.
summary: Humanitarian aid organisation working in over 40 crisis-affected countries and helping resettled refugees and asylum seekers; GiveWell funds its malnutrition treatment and vaccination work.

lines.label: Vaccination incentives
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/International-Rescue-Committee-IRC-Desk-Based-Scoping-of-Programs-to-Increase-Vaccination-Coverage-September-2024%29 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): scoping Sep 2024 $150,000 + vaccination outreach in Salamat and Sila, Chad, Apr 2026 $3,511,707 (https://airtable.com/appaVhon0jdLt1rVs/shrixNMUWCSC5v1lh/tblykYPizxzYj3U1L/viwJ3DyqAUsL654Rm).

lines.label: Malnutrition treatment
lines.source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/international-rescue-committee-malnutrition-treatment-january-2024 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): acute malnutrition Jan 2024 $7,485,323 + Apr 2025 $7,992,256 + Jan 2026 $8,833,269 (https://airtable.com/appaVhon0jdLt1rVs/shrixNMUWCSC5v1lh/tblykYPizxzYj3U1L/viwJ3DyqAUsL654Rm).

lines.label: Crisis response, recovery and development: health, nutrition, vaccination, water, cash, livelihoods, protection and education in crisis-affected countries
lines.source: https://www.rescue.org/irc-document/irc-financial-statement-fy-2025 (audited consolidated statement of functional expenses, year ended September 30 2025, amounts in thousands): Crisis Response, Recovery and Development $753,979 thousand less the GiveWell vaccination and malnutrition grants above, which GiveWell's models cover. charityevals' model of this line covers all of CRRD, that work included, as branches of one humanitarian-relief model.

lines.label: Resettlement, asylum and integration: services and immigration legal help for refugees and other newcomers in the US and Europe
lines.source: https://www.rescue.org/irc-document/irc-financial-statement-fy-2025 (audited consolidated statement of functional expenses, year ended September 30 2025, amounts in thousands): Resettlement, Asylum and Integration $387,441 thousand (U.S. $364,106 thousand, Europe $23,335 thousand), one line that charityevals' resettlement model covers as two branches (services, legal).

spending.source: https://www.rescue.org/irc-document/irc-financial-statement-fy-2025 (audited consolidated statement of functional expenses, year ended September 30 2025, amounts in thousands: total program services $1,141,420 thousand of $1,329,749 thousand total operating expenses; crisis response, recovery and development $753,979 thousand, resettlement, asylum and integration $387,441 thousand)
